item.description: Most people celebrate Christmas as a sweet story about a nice baby, with loving parents, adoring shepherds, and wise men. Christmas is all of that, but it is so much more. item.title: Andalusia’s Candyland adventure draws thousands to South Alabama
item.description: Thousands of visitors are enjoying Andalusia’s Christmas wonderland, known as Candyland.The winter adventure includes play cottages for kids, train rides, Alabama’s largest snow tubing hill, ice skating and decorations galore. item.description: On Monday, United Launch Alliance (ULA) president and CEO Tory Bruno resigned from the company.Before taking the leadership position with ULA, Bruno served as president of Lockheed Martin Strategic and Missile Defense Systems. item.title: Kalen DeBoer forever etched his name in the history books with win over Oklahoma in the College Football Playoffs
item.description: Kalen DeBoer may not be Nick Saban, but he is still one of the best coaches in college football. item.title: 'We're going to take back Birmingham': Tuberville hoping to revitalize Magic City with Fannie Mae relocation
item.description: During a recent interview with "Alabama's Morning News with JT," U.S. Sen. Tommy Tuberville (R-Auburn) praised Federal Housing Finance Agency director Bill Pulte's announcement that Fannie Mae’s offices would be relocating from California to Birmingham.Tuberville, who is running for Alabama governor, said he wanted to "redo" the financial district in downtown Birmingham, noting it was once a "booming enterprise." He added that the move would bring many good jobs to the area and help clean it up.
